column3: Setup: Use the application_state_change testdrive - it supplies a Ready-status update request titled 'Application State Change - Accept Update Request <run_seed>', already linked to its own in-DOAJ journal owned by a real publisher account. OR provide those yourself.

Setup: Important: the testdrive page tears down its data as soon as you navigate away from it. Log in and run the test in a separate browser tab/window, leaving the testdrive tab open until you have finished.
Go to the "Applications/Update Requests" page in the Administration area
Search for the testdrive's "Accept Update Request" record (it is in status Ready) and click "Review update"
Complete any required fields, and then change the Application Status to "Accepted"

column4: A flash message indicates that an existing journal was updated and links to that journal
A flash message indicates that the journal has been associated with an existing user account
A flash message indicates an email has been sent to the owner of the journal
The Application Status field says "Accepted", and a note at the top of the form says "Please note you cannot edit this application as it has been accepted into the DOAJ."

column3: Go to the mailtrap.io inbox for the test environment you are working in

column4: There should be a suitable email to the journal owner indicating that their update request has been accepted
